abstract: Bluehost is an easy host for a first WordPress site. Starter was $3.99 a month on a 36-month term and renews at $11.49. Phone support starts on Business.

description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

mainEntity.name: Is Bluehost a good hosting company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes for beginners building a first WordPress site. TechRadar calls it one of the easiest recommendations, with guided setup and a clear panel. The trade-offs are the renewal price and speed that trails LiteSpeed hosts.

mainEntity.name: Is Bluehost a good web host?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes for small and medium sites with a US audience. WPBeginner measured 100% uptime over 30 days and 933 ms Largest Contentful Paint. Visitors in Asia see slower first responses.

On Bluehost's pricing page on 20 November 2026, Starter was $3.99 a month on a 36-month term, Business $3.49 and eCommerce Essentials $14.99. The 12-month offer was $4.24, $6.79 and $15.99. The full term is charged up front.

The renewal is higher than the first price on every plan. Starter renews at $11.49 a month on a 36-month renewal, 2.9 times the $3.99 first price. WebHostPicks found a month-by-month renewal costs more than a long one.

mainEntity.name: How many websites can I host on Bluehost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starter allows 10 websites, Business 50 and eCommerce Essentials 100. Bluehost says its visit figures of 40,000, 200,000 and 400,000 a month are estimates for the right plan, not limits you can count on.

mainEntity.name: Why does Bluehost have negative reviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: The common complaints are the high renewal price, extras added at checkout and speed behind LiteSpeed hosts. Bluehost itself shows a Trustpilot score of 4.4 from 32,360 reviews. Read the cart and the renewal price before you pay.
Bluehost says it is recommended by WordPress.org, and its pages carry that statement. TechRadar also calls it one of the easiest hosts for a first WordPress site.

mainEntity.name: Does Bluehost have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can cancel within 30 days for a refund of the hosting. The guarantee does not cover most add-ons, and Bluehost deducts the domain fee if your plan included a free domain.
The domain is free for the first year. After that it renews at the then current rate. Check the renewal price of your domain ending before you register it.
Yes on Business and eCommerce Essentials. Starter includes chat only. Chat is available 24/7 on all plans.
On speed and price, Hostinger was ahead in WPBeginner's July 2026 tests: 659 ms against 933 ms. Bluehost offers phone support on higher plans and a guided path for a first WordPress site.

mainEntity.name: Is Bluehost fast enough for my site?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most small sites, yes. Independent tests measured 0.69 s to 0.90 s Largest Contentful Paint in the US. TechRadar saw response times rise under 15 users on a store, so heavier sites may need a bigger plan.
Professional Email starts as a one-month free trial. It then renews at $2.99 a month, according to Bluehost's pricing page.

mainEntity.name: Can I move my site to Bluehost?

acceptedAnswer.text: TechRadar lists migration as included on all three shared plans. Check Bluehost's migration terms before you start.
